coverage_assessment: First-pass January 2023 search completed for Armenia using 14 captured browser-search invocations (56 embedded query strings; 382 returned result headers). Queries covered four weekly date blocks and targeted Yerevan, Gyumri, Vanadzor and Kajaran/Syunik, with Armenian, Russian and English protest, rally, strike and sector terms. The arrays remain grouped by invocation and are not split into invented per-query result groups. Seven body-read and seven search-only source cards support seven event candidates; one is proposed include, two remain pending evidence from search-only leads, one remains pending state-target review, and three remain pending threshold evidence. Two exclusions, three cross-month/announcement leads and 14 gaps retain unresolved source-access, eligibility, target, ownership, territorial and coverage scope. Search coverage is not exhaustive; absence of captured results does not establish absence of events. Source-scope metadata records 7 current-unit body opens and 0 prior-unit-only consultations; the seven reads are partial, with unreviewed material stated in each source card.
